description: Takes produced assets out of the staging area and into the game project: import settings, naming, atlases, references, replacing placeholders. Moves and wires existing files; produces none.
when_to_use: assets exist and are not in the game yet
placeholders have to be swapped for the real thing
the request is about importing, wiring or hooking up assets
avoid_when: the assets do not exist yet
the work is gameplay code rather than asset plumbing
inputs: produced assets in the staging area
outputs: assets imported and referenced in the project
